race.description: Crystalite Linemarking Showcase Super Mdn Hcp
race.comment: Scratching's have decimated the field. INSAIN CHAOS (5) finds his race on the rain affected track after chipping away late when fourth at Beaumont (Newcastle) over 1350m. Well drawn and ready to win. KING KALAKAUA (6) resumed for the new yard when snagged back from the wide gate to run seventh at Taree over 1400m in a Super Maiden. Awkward gate again and look for a better performance. CASINO SHARKY (4) raced without luck when eighth at Port Macquarie after making ground late over 1500m at Port Macquarie. Well drawn and expected to take a hand in the finish.  SLEUTH (11) much better showing third up when third at Port Macquarie over 1500m. Drops further in weight and not to concerned about the wide gate. Each way.
